scenes.label: WordPress, honestly
lines: Is it still the right fit?
scenes.sub: Page builder vs custom theme: an honest look.
scenes.vo: Your page builder was a great start. But is it still the right fit for your business?

scenes.title: Same design, two ways to build it
scenes.vo: A page builder wraps your content in extra layers and loads code for features you may never use. A custom theme ships only what your site needs.

scenes.title: Custom blocks your team can edit
lines: // One block, built for your brand
scenes.caption: Editors fill in fields. The design stays on-brand.
scenes.vo: With custom blocks, your team still edits content in WordPress, and the design stays on-brand.

scenes.title: When a page builder is fine
scenes.vo: A page builder is still fine for short campaigns, a quick first launch, or teams who change layouts all the time.

scenes.title: Moving to a custom theme
scenes.vo: If you're ready to move, we audit your pages, build custom blocks for your brand, then rebuild and test on real phones.

scenes.sub: Custom WordPress themes, blocks and WooCommerce stores.
scenes.vo: Outgrown your page builder? Ask SK Developer on WhatsApp, and let's build a theme that fits your brand.

scenes.tagline: Custom WordPress themes, plugins and full-stack web apps
